Wrangler Air box

55 × 63 × 35 mm, one box: DinMeter in the top face, screen up; relay flat on the floor, ADC on top of it. The back cover is taped to the tunnel wall, the body clicks onto it (2 snap tabs in the side walls, no screws). Car wires go out through a slot in the cover, behind the trim · drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom
